events.title: JawnCon
events.description:
DC215
JawnCon is an event that celebrates the evolution of security and technology in our lives. Forged in the fires that are everything Philly, this event is driven to educate, celebrate and better understand all the things that make these weird machines blink and go bump in the night. For more information please go to:

https://jawncon.org/
